sqlite.name: station_tracking_sessions
sqlite.sql:
CREATE TABLE station_tracking_sessions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	station_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	tracker_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_by INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	ended_at DATETIME, 
	ended_by INTEGER, 
	end_reason VARCHAR(500), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_station_tracking_session_window CHECK (expires_at > created_at), 
	FOREIGN KEY(station_id) REFERENCES stations (station_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tracker_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(ended_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)

indexes.name: ix_station_tracking_sessions_station
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_station_tracking_sessions_station ON station_tracking_sessions (station_id, created_at)

sqlite.name: station_tracked_positions
sqlite.sql:
CREATE TABLE station_tracked_positions (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	session_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	station_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	latitude FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	longitude FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	accuracy_m FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	captured_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	received_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_station_tracked_latitude CHECK (latitude >= -90 AND latitude <= 90), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_station_tracked_longitude CHECK (longitude >= -180 AND longitude <= 180), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_station_tracked_accuracy CHECK (accuracy_m > 0 AND accuracy_m <= 50), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES station_tracking_sessions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(station_id) REFERENCES stations (station_id)
)

indexes.name: ix_station_tracked_positions_session
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_station_tracked_positions_session ON station_tracked_positions (session_id, captured_at)

indexes.name: ix_station_tracked_positions_station
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_station_tracked_positions_station ON station_tracked_positions (station_id, captured_at)
